name: The Golden Throne
oracle_text:
Arcane Life-support — If you would lose the game, instead exile The Golden Throne and your life total becomes 1.
A Thousand Souls Die Every Day — {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Add three mana in any combination of colors.
blocked_sentences: Arcane Life-support — If you would lose the game, instead exile The Golden Throne and your life total becomes 1.

needs.what: a static replacement on a permanent for its controller losing the game (any cause: 0 life, poison, commander damage, empty-library draw, lose_game op) that instead performs effects (exile this permanent, set your life total to 1) and the player stays in the game; one-shot because the source is exiled
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cant_lose_the_game static/op only forbids losing (Platinum Angel) and runs no replacement effects, so the source never exiles itself and the life total never becomes 1; no replace_* static covers the lose-the-game event and there is no op that sets a life total to a number
